items.title: Corner window: one way back
items.text: Press OK twice from anywhere to focus the corner window. A ring and a key panel show it, then press OK for full screen. The Blue key works too, on remotes that have one.

items.title: Watch party is ready
items.text: The watch party server is built in now. Play a film, open Watch party, and choose Start a watch party.

items.title: Microphone in one press
items.text: On the search keyboard, press Back from any key to jump to the microphone.
